descriptions.fashion: Taiwan clothing brands stand out for textile expertise built through decades of mills, dye houses, and technical fabric suppliers. Designers pair that manufacturing base with practical cuts, climate-aware materials, and a sharp contemporary point of view. You will find everyday essentials, outdoor-ready layers, and independent labels with global ambitions. Formoria highlights fashion shaped by both craft know-how and modern Taiwanese life.
descriptions.bags-accessories: Taiwan bag brands often grow from a deep leather-working tradition and the island's practical manufacturing culture. Many workshops combine hand finishing, precise stitching, recycled fabrics, vegan leather, or other sustainable materials. The result is gear made for commuting, travel, and daily use without losing character. On Formoria, visitors can discover artisan studios, small-batch makers, and design-led labels refining how a bag should work.
descriptions.jewelry: Taiwan jewelry brands blend traditional metalwork with contemporary design, creating pieces that range from minimalist everyday accessories to bold statement works. Many makers source natural gemstones, freshwater pearls, and recycled metals, often combining hand finishing with modern techniques. Formoria showcases earrings, necklaces, rings, and bracelets from independent designers who bring personal artistry to wearable form.
descriptions.beauty: Taiwan beauty brands combine herbal wisdom, ingredient transparency, and cosmetic science tuned for humid subtropical weather. Formulas often focus on lightweight hydration, gentle repair, sun care, and calming botanicals suited to daily routines. Many labels use local plants, mineral springs, biotech actives, or clean manufacturing standards. Formoria introduces skincare, haircare, body care, and makeup brands that connect natural materials with precise modern formulation.
descriptions.home: Taiwan home brands bring together ceramics, woodworking, bamboo weaving, metal craft, and compact urban living design. Makers often create objects that are modest in footprint but rich in material detail, from tableware and storage to lighting and decor. The category reflects both studio craft and the island's habit of making small spaces work beautifully. On Formoria, visitors can find practical pieces, heirloom-quality objects, and thoughtful designs for everyday rituals.
descriptions.food-drink: Taiwan food and drink brands reflect an island where Hoklo, Hakka, Indigenous, Japanese, and global influences meet. Subtropical farms supply fruit, grains, tea, spices, and seafood, while many makers work directly with growers or regional producers. From pantry staples to high-mountain oolong and specialty coffee, Formoria helps visitors trace these products back to local ingredients, family recipes, and new culinary ideas.
descriptions.crafts: Taiwan craft brands preserve artisanal traditions while giving them practical contemporary forms. Letterpress studios, ceramicists, textile artists, woodworkers, metalworkers, and leather artisans keep slow processes alive through small-batch production. Their work often carries local stories, temple culture, regional materials, or memories of older trades. On Formoria, visitors can discover handmade objects that connect cultural preservation with design for modern use.
descriptions.stationery: Taiwan stationery brands benefit from precision engineering, print expertise, and a lively maker culture. Fountain pens, notebooks, planners, stamps, handmade paper, and desk tools often combine reliable function with expressive illustration or typography. Many makers work with local printers, paper mills, and independent artists. Formoria gathers writing and paper goods that show how Taiwan turns small tools into objects of care, creativity, and daily pleasure.
descriptions.tech: Taiwan tech brands are shaped by the island's semiconductor ecosystem, engineering talent, and world-class hardware supply chains. Consumer electronics, creator tools, peripherals, smart home devices, and specialist components often show a strong balance of reliability, usability, and production quality. Many teams can move from prototype to manufacturing with unusual speed. Formoria helps visitors find technology brands that turn Taiwan's industrial depth into products for everyday users.
descriptions.outdoor: Taiwan outdoor brands draw on the island's dramatic mountain terrain, subtropical trails, and year-round camping culture. Gear designers create lightweight, durable equipment tested in local conditions — from high-altitude ridgelines to coastal campgrounds. Many brands emphasize handmade craftsmanship, sustainable materials, and repair-friendly design. Formoria showcases backpacks, camping gear, and climbing equipment made for real adventures.
descriptions.fitness: Taiwan fitness and sports brands combine functional design with the island's active lifestyle culture. From yoga mats and resistance equipment to performance apparel and recovery tools, makers focus on ergonomic detail and material quality. Many brands serve both gym-goers and outdoor athletes with products tested in Taiwan's humid climate. Formoria introduces fitness gear and sportswear brands that prioritize function, comfort, and durability.
descriptions.kids-pets: Taiwan kids and pet brands reflect a culture that values safety, gentle materials, and thoughtful design for the youngest family members and their animal companions. Organic cotton clothing, wooden toys, non-toxic accessories, and handmade pet gear are common across the category. Many makers hold international safety certifications and use locally sourced materials. Formoria gathers brands that bring care and creativity to products for children, babies, and pets.

home.title: Taiwan Home & Living Brands | Furniture, Tableware & Everyday Objects | Formoria
home.description: Explore Taiwanese home and living brands, from furniture and storage to tableware and objects designed for daily life.
home.intro: Home and living covers furniture, storage, lighting, tableware, and everyday decor. Formoria organises these brands by primary use and the product tags supplied with approved listings.
home.definition: This category focuses on objects that make a living space more useful, not only decorative pieces. Brands may work in ceramics, wood, bamboo, metal, or mixed materials; inclusion reflects a clear Taiwan connection through founding, design, or manufacturing and the product types recorded for the brand.

faq.question: What products appear in Home & Living?
faq.answer: Common examples include furniture, storage, lighting, tableware, fragrance, and small decor objects. The exact tags follow each brand's main products.

faq.question: Are all brands in this category made in Taiwan?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Formoria lists brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan; manufacturing details are shown separately when a brand provides them.

fashion.title: Taiwan Fashion & Apparel Brands | Clothing, Shoes & Accessories | Formoria
fashion.description: Explore Taiwanese fashion and apparel brands across tops, shoes, and everyday clothing, with design and material details.
fashion.intro: Fashion and apparel covers clothing, footwear, and pieces worn with them. Formoria groups everyday, technical, and design-led labels by their main wearables and product tags.
fashion.definition: A fashion brand's point of view may come from cut, textile, last, or the setting in which a piece is worn. This category does not claim that every item is made in Taiwan; each listing records its Taiwan connection and available product evidence separately.

faq.question: What brands are included in Fashion & Apparel?
faq.answer: Everyday clothing, technical layers, casual shoes, leather shoes, and other wearables may appear when they match a brand's main products and public tags.

faq.question: Where can I find a brand's origin details?
faq.answer: Each brand page separates founding, design, and manufacturing information. The category page does not treat every listed label as Taiwan-made.

beauty.title: Taiwan Beauty & Personal Care Brands | Skincare, Haircare & Body Care | Formoria
beauty.description: Explore Taiwanese beauty and personal care brands across skincare, haircare, body care, and daily cleansing routines.
beauty.intro: Beauty and personal care covers skin, hair, body, makeup, and cleansing products. Formoria sorts brands by use and product tags so different steps in a routine remain easy to compare.
beauty.definition: The category is organised by body area and function, not by a promise that a product is natural, additive-free, or suitable for every skin type. A brand may be founded, designed, or manufactured in Taiwan; confirm formula, claims, and manufacturing details on its own listing.

faq.question: What products are in Beauty & Personal Care?
faq.answer: Skincare, body care, bath and shower, haircare, makeup, fragrance, and sun care can all appear, with narrower subcategories for primary use.

faq.question: Does Formoria endorse a beauty product?
faq.answer: No. The directory organises brand and product information and shows available declarations or verification; follow product labels and professional advice for use.

food-drink.title: Taiwan Food & Beverage Brands | Tea, Coffee, Snacks & Pantry Goods | Formoria
food-drink.description: Explore Taiwanese food and beverage brands, from tea and coffee to snacks, sauces, desserts, and everyday ingredients.
food-drink.intro: Food and beverage covers edible ingredients, prepared foods, and drinks. Formoria groups brands by their main products and tags, keeping tea, coffee, snacks, and regional flavours distinct.
food-drink.definition: A food brand may be defined by its ingredients, source, recipe, processing method, or family practice. This category does not imply that every ingredient or product is Taiwan-made; listings show the brand's Taiwan connection and point to public information about origin and production.

faq.question: What can I find in Food & Beverage?
faq.answer: Tea, coffee, dried fruit, snacks, sauces, baked goods, and other everyday foods may appear, then sort into narrower subcategories by main product.

faq.question: Does a category label mean all ingredients are from Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. The label is a discovery path, not an origin claim. Check each brand page for ingredient, source, and manufacturing information.

crafts.title: Taiwan Crafts & Art Brands | Ceramics, Woodwork, Textiles & Handmade Design | Formoria
crafts.description: Explore Taiwanese crafts and art brands across ceramics, woodwork, textiles, metalwork, print, and contemporary making.
crafts.intro: Crafts and art centre process, material, and cultural interpretation. Formoria groups ceramicists, woodworkers, textile artists, metalworkers, and print studios by the work they make.
crafts.definition: Craft does not mean every piece is entirely handmade, nor does it stand for one cultural tradition. Formoria looks at a brand's published processes, product types, and Taiwan connection so visitors can learn more about studio scale, materials, and making on the brand page.

faq.question: How is Crafts & Art different from Home & Living?
faq.answer: The categories can overlap. Crafts & Art foregrounds process, material, and cultural context, while Home & Living foregrounds how an object works in a space.

faq.question: Are handmade brands automatically made in Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. Formoria keeps founding, design, and manufacturing details separate instead of using a category name as a substitute for origin information.

bags-accessories.title: Taiwan Bags & Accessories Brands | Bags, Leather Goods & Everyday Carry | Formoria
bags-accessories.description: Explore Taiwanese bags and accessories brands, from backpacks and wallets to eyewear, hats, and travel pieces.
bags-accessories.intro: Bags and accessories covers objects used to carry, organise, or complete an outfit. Formoria groups bags, leather goods, and personal accessories by their primary function for commuting, travel, and daily use.
bags-accessories.definition: A brand may make bags, wallets, and other accessories at the same time, so subcategories follow the main product tags. Inclusion does not mean every item shares one material or manufacturing location; check the listing for the brand's own material and origin details.

faq.question: Which subcategories are included?
faq.answer: Backpacks, tote bags, crossbody bags, wallets, eyewear, hats, and travel accessories can appear when they match a brand's main product range.

faq.question: Do all leather-goods brands use real leather?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Brands may use leather, plant-based alternatives, recycled fabric, or other materials; each listing should be checked for the actual specification.

jewelry.title: Taiwan Jewelry Brands | Earrings, Necklaces, Rings & Bracelets | Formoria
jewelry.description: Explore Taiwanese jewelry brands across earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, and other wearable design pieces.
jewelry.intro: Jewelry centres on wearable metalwork, materials, and design. Formoria groups earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, and hair accessories by a brand's main product types.
jewelry.definition: This category includes everyday accessories and jewellery design without assuming that every piece uses precious metal, natural stones, or Taiwan-sourced material. Where available, brand pages separate material, making, and origin details so visitors can understand each label's work.

faq.question: How are jewelry and accessories organised here?
faq.answer: Primary product and how a piece is worn guide the subcategory, so everyday accessories and fine-jewelry labels can share an earrings, necklace, or ring page.

faq.question: Does Formoria verify the material of every piece?
faq.answer: No. Check the brand's material, stone, and production information; a category label is not a material guarantee.

kids-pets.title: Taiwan Kids, Baby & Pet Brands | Clothing, Toys & Everyday Care | Formoria
kids-pets.description: Explore Taiwanese kids, baby, and pet brands across clothing, toys, accessories, and everyday care products.
kids-pets.intro: Kids, baby, and pets covers products for children, infants, and animal companions. Formoria groups toys, clothing, accessories, and care products by user, purpose, and brand tags.
kids-pets.definition: Safety, sizing, and age guidance are important reading cues, but the directory does not replace regulations, testing, or medical advice. A brand may be founded, designed, or manufactured in Taiwan; check its listing, packaging, and product guidance for the details that matter.

faq.question: What products appear in Kids, Baby & Pets?
faq.answer: Children's and baby clothing, toys, feeding goods, home items, pet food, and pet accessories may all appear in this category.

faq.question: Does Formoria confirm that a product suits every child or pet?
faq.answer: No. The directory organises public brand information; age, size, safety, and care decisions should follow the product label and professional guidance.

stationery.title: Taiwan Stationery & Design Brands | Pens, Paper Goods & Desk Tools | Formoria
stationery.description: Explore Taiwanese stationery and design brands across writing tools, notebooks, paper goods, and desk accessories.
stationery.intro: Stationery and design covers tools for writing, recording, organising, and working at a desk. Formoria groups brands by function and by tags for paper goods, pens, printing, and desk tools.
stationery.definition: A stationery product can differ through paper, ink, print, mechanism, or illustration rather than appearance alone. The Taiwan connection, manufacturing partners, and materials vary by brand, so the brand page remains the place to learn the specific details.

faq.question: What products are included in Stationery & Design?
faq.answer: Pens, notebooks, planners, paper goods, stamps, stickers, and desk organisers can appear, grouped by their primary use and product tags.

faq.question: Are stationery products all made in Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. A brand may be founded, designed, or manufactured in Taiwan; each listing shows the available origin and production information separately.

outdoor.title: Taiwan Outdoor & Camping Brands | Hiking, Camping & Adventure Gear | Formoria
outdoor.description: Explore Taiwanese outdoor and camping brands across hiking, camping, climbing, and equipment for time outside.
outdoor.intro: Outdoor and camping covers gear for hiking, camping, climbing, and travel outside. Formoria groups apparel, packs, shelters, and accessories by activity, use, and brand tags.
outdoor.definition: Terrain, weather, and user experience affect whether a piece of gear is appropriate; this category does not make safety or performance guarantees. Founding, design, and manufacturing connections are recorded separately, while specifications and load limits belong to each brand's product page.

faq.question: Which activities are covered by Outdoor & Camping?
faq.answer: Hiking, camping, climbing, and outdoor travel gear may appear, with subcategories that follow a product's primary use.

faq.question: Is every item here suitable for high-altitude trips?

bath-and-shower.title: Taiwan Bath & Shower Brands | Cleansing for Daily Routines | Formoria
bath-and-shower.description: Explore Taiwanese bath and shower brands across body wash, facial cleansing, and everyday personal care.
bath-and-shower.intro: Bath and shower focuses on bathing, facial cleansing, and body cleansing products. Formoria groups these brands from Beauty & Personal Care by body area and primary function.
bath-and-shower.definition: This subcategory is about cleansing use, not a promise that a formula suits every skin type or has a particular origin. Check ingredients, directions, and the brand's available Taiwan connection and manufacturing details.

faq.question: Can sensitive skin use every product here?

necklaces.description: Explore Taiwanese necklace brands, from daily pendants to metalwork and design-led pieces, organised by material and style.
necklaces.intro: Necklaces are worn around the neck and may combine chains, pendants, beads, or other materials. Formoria groups these jewelry brands by their main necklace products and tags.
necklaces.definition: A necklace may use metal, stone, pearl, textile, or another material; this subcategory does not guarantee allergy, durability, or origin characteristics. Refer to the brand listing and product description for specifics.

faq.question: Can handmade labels appear in Necklaces?
faq.answer: Yes. A brand can appear when necklaces or pendants are among its primary products and it meets Formoria's directory scope.

faq.question: How do I confirm a necklace's material?

earrings.description: Explore Taiwanese earring brands, from studs and clip-ons to handmade designs, organised by wear and style.

earrings.definition: Weight, fastening, material, and fit affect how earrings feel; this subcategory does not replace product specifications or allergy information. The brand page explains its available founding, design, and manufacturing connection to Taiwan.

faq.answer: Yes. Clip-ons and stud earrings are both ear-worn products, and brands are grouped according to their public product tags.

faq.question: What appears in Furniture?
faq.answer: Tables, chairs, cabinets, bed frames, and other objects that support everyday activities may appear in this subcategory.

faq.question: Can I buy furniture directly from Formoria?
faq.answer: Formoria is a brand discovery directory. Visit the official channel provided by each brand for pricing, dimensions, delivery, and purchase details.

skincare.description: Explore Taiwanese skincare brands across cleansing, hydration, repair, and everyday facial care routines.
skincare.intro: Skincare includes cleansing, toners, serums, moisturisers, masks, and related steps. Formoria groups Beauty & Personal Care brands by use and product tags.
skincare.definition: Skin needs vary with the person, season, and formula; this subcategory does not offer diagnosis or efficacy guarantees. Use the full ingredient list, directions, and available manufacturing or verification information when choosing.

faq.question: Does Skincare include makeup?
faq.answer: It focuses on care and cleansing; makeup appears in other Beauty & Personal Care subcategories, although a brand may cover several uses.

faq.question: Are product claims verified by Formoria?
faq.answer: No. Formoria organises brand information rather than endorsing product claims. Follow the label and professional guidance.

tops-and-tshirts.title: Taiwan Tops & T-shirt Brands | Everyday Cuts & Technical Layers | Formoria
tops-and-tshirts.description: Explore Taiwanese tops and T-shirt brands across basics, shirts, and technical layers for everyday wear.
tops-and-tshirts.intro: Tops and T-shirts cover clothing worn on the upper body. Formoria groups Fashion & Apparel brands by cut, textile, and product tags for everyday and technical wear.
tops-and-tshirts.definition: This subcategory can include T-shirts, shirts, hoodies, polo shirts, and knitwear, without assuming a fabric, fit, or manufacturing location. Check the product page for size, care, and origin details.

faq.question: Are shirts included with T-shirts?
faq.answer: A brand may appear when shirts or other upper-body garments are part of its main range; the exact route follows its product tags.

faq.question: How can I confirm a top's fabric and origin?
faq.answer: Read the product page's material, care, size, and origin fields. The subcategory does not imply that every piece is made in Taiwan.

tableware.title: Taiwan Tableware Brands | Ceramics, Glassware & Everyday Dining | Formoria
tableware.description: Explore Taiwanese tableware brands across plates, cups, bowls, and accessories for everyday dining.
tableware.intro: Tableware holds, serves, or helps prepare food and drinks. Formoria groups Home & Living brands by use and material tags for plates, cups, bowls, and dining accessories.
tableware.definition: Ceramic, glass, wood, and metal tableware have different care, heat, and use limits. This subcategory does not guarantee food-contact or safety certification; read each brand's specifications and care instructions.

faq.question: Does Tableware include kitchen tools?
faq.answer: It focuses on objects used for serving and dining. Products mainly used for cooking or kitchen storage may appear in another Home & Living route.

faq.question: How do I know if a piece is microwave or dishwasher safe?
faq.answer: Use the brand's product page and packaging guidance rather than inferring use from the material name alone.

casual-shoes.title: Taiwan Casual Shoe Brands | Everyday Footwear, Canvas & Easygoing Styles | Formoria
casual-shoes.description: Explore Taiwanese casual shoe brands, from canvas sneakers and simple trainers to everyday slip-ons.
casual-shoes.intro: Casual shoes are designed for everyday walking and informal wear. Formoria groups Fashion & Apparel brands by shoe structure, material, and product tags for daily use.
casual-shoes.definition: Casual does not mean suitable for every sport or terrain; sole, support, fit, and weather conditions differ between pairs. Read the brand's specifications, sizing guidance, and manufacturing details before choosing.

faq.question: How are casual shoes different from sports shoes?
faq.answer: Casual shoes are primarily for everyday wear, while sports shoes are designed around a specific activity and support need; follow the brand's stated use and specifications.

faq.question: Are casual shoe brands all made in Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. Formoria separates a brand's founding, design, and manufacturing information. Check the individual listing for origin details.

desserts-and-pastries.title: Taiwan Dessert & Pastry Brands | Baked Goods, Treats & Local Flavours | Formoria
desserts-and-pastries.description: Explore Taiwanese dessert and pastry brands across baking, confectionery, gifts, and regional treats.
desserts-and-pastries.intro: Desserts and pastries include baked goods, confectionery, cookies, and regional treats. Formoria groups Food & Beverage brands by their main sweet products and product tags.
desserts-and-pastries.definition: Ingredients, shelf life, allergens, and delivery conditions vary by product. This subcategory does not replace food labelling or storage guidance; brand pages provide the available Taiwan connection and production details.

faq.question: What belongs in Desserts & Pastries?
faq.answer: Cakes, breads, cookies, candy, traditional pastries, and other sweet treats may appear, grouped by a brand's main products.

faq.question: Is this a food-safety recommendation?
faq.answer: No. The directory is a discovery entry point. Use packaging, storage, allergen, and official-channel information when deciding what to buy.

We do not sell your personal information or brand data to third parties. Data use is governed by these terms and our privacy policy.

automatedAccess.heading: Automated Access and Data Extraction
automatedAccess.body: Ordinary browsing, approved search-engine indexing, and citation that attributes Formoria and links back to the source page all remain permitted. metadata.description: Learn how Formoria collects, processes, and uses your personal data in compliance with Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Formoria values your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, process, and use your personal data in accordance with Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (個人資料保護法).

dataCollection.heading: Data Collection
dataCollection.body: When you use Formoria, we may collect your email address and optional name when you recommend a brand, provide brand details, send feedback, or contact support, along with brand details, social and purchase links, ownership status, and source attribution. When you create an account, we collect your email and authentication details through Supabase Auth. If you choose to receive marketing email, we also record the consent category, source, version, and time. We collect browsing and product-usage events through PostHog and continue collecting Google Analytics data. Analytics events record the words you type into site search, so we can see what visitors are looking for and add the brands they cannot find; a search that looks like an email address or a phone number is not recorded at all. Analytics events exclude form values, names, email addresses, phone numbers, authentication codes, and tokens.

purpose.heading: Purpose of Use
purpose.body: We collect personal data to build and maintain the Taiwan brand directory, provide discovery and search, improve brand information, prevent spam and abuse, improve the service, and send recommendation, claim, verification, security, and account-related notices. We send newsletters or owner lifecycle content such as operating reminders and feature guidance only after separate consent; you can turn off either marketing category independently. Declining marketing email does not affect brand recommendations, account creation, or core service access.

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: To provide our service, we use the following third-party providers: Supabase (database and authentication, servers in the US), Resend (email delivery, data may be processed in the US), PostHog and Google Analytics 4 (website analytics, data processed in the US), Sentry (error monitoring, data processed in the US), Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection), and Railway (web hosting, servers in the US). We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Data is shared only to the extent necessary to provide our services.

userRights.heading: Your Rights
userRights.body: Under Article 3 of the Personal Data Protection Act, you have the right to: query or request access to your personal data, request a copy, request corrections or supplements, request cessation of collection, processing, or use, and request deletion. To exercise any of these rights, please contact privacy@formoria.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days.

dataProtection.heading: Data Protection
dataProtection.body: We protect personal data with HTTPS, access controls, and regular security reviews. Brand data is retained while the brand is listed, account data while the account remains active, and marketing-consent records until you withdraw consent or request deletion. After an unsubscribe request, we may retain a minimal suppression record so we do not send marketing email you have declined.

cookies.heading: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.body: This website uses PostHog and Google Analytics 4 to record page views and usage events. PostHog is delivered through our e.formoria.com analytics endpoint, does not retain IP addresses, and has session replay disabled. Cloudflare Turnstile uses session cookies for bot detection to protect forms from spam. We do not use advertising cookies.

changes.heading: Policy Changes
changes.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the service after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or wish to exercise your personal data rights, please contact: privacy@formoria.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days as required by the Personal Data Protection Act.

metadata.title: FAQ
metadata.description: Frequently asked questions about Formoria's Taiwanese brand discovery and curation platform, including listings versus selections, purchase channels, trust tiers, recommendations, and the review process.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Start with the life you want and find Taiwanese products that suit you. If your question is not answered here, please <contact>contact us</contact>.

whatIsFormoria.question: What is Formoria?
whatIsFormoria.answer: Formoria is a Taiwanese brand discovery and curation platform. It currently starts with a searchable directory of listed brands, bringing together brand information, product highlights, and official purchase channels; content selected by Formoria is labelled separately.

listingVsSelection.question: What is the difference between a listed brand and a Formoria Selection?
listingVsSelection.answer: A listed brand meets the directory rules and can be found in the searchable record; listing is not Formoria endorsement, selection, certification, or ranking. A Formoria Selection is a product or content item deliberately chosen for a situation, use, preference, or editorial argument, and is labelled separately with its rationale.

purchaseThroughFormoria.question: Can I purchase through Formoria?
purchaseThroughFormoria.answer: No. Formoria owns inspiration, selection, context, and the outbound route; it does not accept orders or process checkout. Brands or retailers remain responsible for price, variants, inventory, checkout, fulfilment, and after-sales service.

whoCanSubmit.question: Who can recommend a brand?
whoCanSubmit.answer: Anyone can recommend a brand — you do not need to be the owner. Brand owners can also use the owner flow to provide complete details and claim the listing after approval.

taiwaneseBrandCriteria.question: What counts as a Taiwanese brand?
taiwaneseBrandCriteria.answer: A brand qualifies if it was founded, designed, or manufactured in Taiwan — meeting any one of the three is enough. For example, a company headquartered in Taipei qualifies under 'founded'; a studio that designs products in Taiwan but manufactures overseas qualifies under 'designed'; a workshop producing goods in Yingge qualifies under 'manufactured'. We welcome recommendations from brand owners, fans, and community members alike.

notListedBrands.question: What kinds of brands are not listed?
notListedBrands.answer: Formoria lists brands with their own products, so we do not list proxy buyers, curated or multi-brand shops without a product line of their own, platforms and retail channels, media and review sites, importers or distributors of foreign brands, or personal accounts offering only services or digital goods. A curated shop that makes its own product line, or a creator with their own physical products, does qualify.

whatDoesMitMean.question: What do the MIT tiers mean?
whatDoesMitMean.answer: MIT Verified means Formoria matched a product to the official MIT Smile registry. MIT Declared means the brand owner stated whether some, most, or all products are made in Taiwan. Neither tier implies that every product from the brand is made in Taiwan; check the listed scope and evidence.

howToSubmit.question: How do I recommend a brand to Formoria?
howToSubmit.answer: Anyone can share a brand through our recommendation form. Go to Recommend a Brand, provide the brand name and an official link, and the Formoria team will review it. There is no fee; we check that the information is complete, the brand exists, and it has a genuine connection to Taiwan.

reviewTime.question: How long does the brand review take?
reviewTime.answer: Brand reviews generally take about 7 business days. We check that the brand exists, the information is complete, and it meets our inclusion criteria. Approved brands then appear in the directory; if information is missing, we may contact the person who recommended it by email.

dataAccuracy.question: How is the accuracy of brand information ensured?
dataAccuracy.answer: Formoria collects brand information through community contributions and our admin team performs an initial review during the approval process. If you find any brand information that is incorrect or outdated, please let us know through our contact channel and we'll address it promptly.

isBrandFree.question: Is it free to list a brand on Formoria?
isBrandFree.answer: Yes. Recommending a brand to Formoria is free, and brand owners, fans, and community members are all welcome to help build the Taiwanese brand directory.

ownerInterest.question: I own a brand — can I manage my own brand page yet?
ownerInterest.answer: Not yet. Owner tools — claiming your brand page, editing it yourself, and submitting MIT declarations — are coming soon. Until then our team keeps listings up to date, so email us any correction and we'll apply it. If you want owner tools, register your interest on the <link>feature request board</link> and we'll let you know the moment they open.

whatCategories.question: What product categories does Formoria cover?
whatCategories.answer: Formoria covers twelve categories: Fashion & Apparel, Bags & Accessories, Jewelry, Beauty & Personal Care, Home & Living, Food & Beverage, Crafts & Art, Stationery & Design, Tech & Electronics, Outdoor & Camping, Sports & Fitness, and Kids Baby & Pets.

languageSupport.question: Is Formoria available in English?
languageSupport.answer: Yes, Formoria is fully bilingual in English and Traditional Chinese (zh-TW). You can switch languages using the language toggle in the navigation bar.

howVerified.question: How does brand verification work?
howVerified.answer: Listing review checks that a brand exists and meets our inclusion criteria. Owner verification confirms who may manage the page. Manufacturing signals are separate: MIT Verified is matched to the official MIT Smile registry, while MIT Declared records the scope stated by the brand owner.

contact.question: How do I contact the Formoria team?
contact.answer: For any questions, suggestions, or partnership inquiries, visit our <link>contact page</link> to pick the right channel. Our team typically responds within 2–3 business days.

metadata.description: Formoria reconnects the broken path from inspiration to purchase by helping people start with the life they want, find Taiwanese products that suit them, get to know the brands behind them, and know where to buy.

audiences.heading: Two ways to look, one connected path
audiences.intro: Some visitors do not know a name yet and want to start with a way of living, a use, or a preference. Others already know a brand or category and want to research it clearly. Formoria serves both kinds of discovery.

wander.heading: When you do not know the name
wander.body: Start with the life you want, a situation, or a curiosity, then discover products and brands across categories.

research.heading: When you know the direction
research.body: Search for a brand or category, then review brand information, product highlights, and official or physical channels.

mission.heading: Formoria's three roles
mission.statement: Formoria is a Taiwanese brand discovery and curation platform. It currently starts with a searchable directory of listed brands, bringing together brand information, product highlights, and official purchase channels; content selected by Formoria is labelled separately.
mission.context: Directory listing, editorial selection, and the route to purchase each have a clear boundary, so visitors know what they are seeing and who owns the next step.

directory.heading: An inclusive brand directory
directory.body: Organize Taiwanese brands under public listing rules, making known names searchable and giving different parts of life a place to begin exploring.

editorial.heading: Selective editorial with reasons
editorial.body: Formoria uses “Formoria Selection” only for products or content deliberately chosen for a situation, use, preference, or editorial argument, with the reason made clear.

connection.heading: A connection to real purchase channels
connection.body: Provide the next step to a brand's official website or a physical channel. Formoria does not accept orders or guarantee price, inventory, or transaction outcomes.

trust.heading: Understand every label
trust.intro: These four labels explain why something appears on Formoria and who is responsible for it.

listed.heading: 收錄品牌 (Listed brand)
listed.body: A brand that meets Formoria's directory rules and can be found in the searchable record. Inclusion is not Formoria endorsement, selection, certification, ranking, or a promise about current products.

selected.heading: Formoria 選物 (Formoria Selection)
selected.body: A product or content item deliberately chosen for a stated situation, use, preference, or editorial argument. The rationale belongs to Formoria; it is not a claim that the item is universally best or the complete brand catalogue.

brandProvided.heading: 品牌提供 (Brand-provided)
brandProvided.body: Facts, images, sources, or corrections supplied by a brand. Participation does not guarantee coverage or give the brand control over selection, ordering, rationale, or interpretation.

sponsored.heading: 贊助內容 (Sponsored content)
sponsored.body: Paid or commercial content is clearly labelled and kept distinct. It cannot enter organic selection or ranking logic, and relevant relationships are disclosed at the point of action.

trust.formoriaOwns: Formoria owns inspiration, selection, context, and the outbound route.
trust.merchantOwns: Brands or retailers remain responsible for price, variants, inventory, checkout, fulfilment, and after-sales service.

vision.heading: Build an online select space for Taiwanese brands where people can browse at their own pace, discover new preferences, get to know the brands behind the products, then continue to brands' official or physical channels.
vision.body: This is a long-term direction, not a claim that Formoria currently accepts orders, holds inventory, processes payments, or provides after-sales service.
vision.principleHeading: Transactions stay with brands and retailers
vision.principleBody: Formoria owns inspiration, selection, context, and the outbound route; brands or retailers remain responsible for price, variants, inventory, checkout, fulfilment, and after-sales service.

taiwanStats.heading: Why supporting Taiwan's small businesses matters

taiwanStats.note: Together they generate over NT$28 trillion in annual sales — more than half of all enterprise revenue. Backing one Taiwan brand backs the everyday life of the island.
